kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اعتصروا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَرُوا (iʕtaṣarū) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اُعْتُصِرُوا (uʕtuṣirū) /uʕ.tu.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اِعْتَصِرُوا (iʕtaṣirū) /iʕ.ta.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
